calls.statement:
SELECT sale_date, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_lines, sum(quantity) AS units, min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE store_key = 37 AND product_key = 1702 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-21' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT max(sale_date) AS max_sale, count(*) AS n, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, (SELECT max(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS max_dim_date, (SELECT string_agg(fiscal_period_label || ':' || fully_loaded, ', ') FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27') AS fc FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT sales_line_id, receipt_id, line_no, sale_date, sale_ts_utc, member_key, channel_code, channel_id, quantity, net_amount, gross_amount, standard_cost, staff_purchase_flag, etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE store_key = 37 AND product_key = 1702 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-27' AND DATE '2026-10-05' ORDER BY sale_ts_utc
